steps.content: The shadow in the flame is still wiggling and is hard to clear. The Rustfire members coming to help are already ashen-faced.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: What's that thing?! Is it also a trap by the Executive Committee?

steps.speaker: Options
options: Just smoke and mirrors. Stay away from it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whatever you hear and see, don't think too much about it. Know how to suppress your emotions? Protect yourselves and those around you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Make everyone go back inside. Now...
Before you finish, the flame suddenly dwindles. Surprisingly, you see a pitch-black human shape. He stops struggling and makes a shrill roar abruptly. It's a terrifying laugh.
The windows in the whole alley shatter. You hear miserable cries from inside the buildings.
As if petrified, Lavina drops the communications device, shattering it. Hella gets hold of her in time, fearing she may be the next one to break.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Lavina? Lavina? ****! This is what happens when you don't get used to beating people up. ${PlayerName}, think of something!

Before it lets out another wave of screams, several bolts of blue light flash by. Metal wires are shot from the beams, entangling the wiggling shadow. Next, an enormous mechanical arm spins and smashes down, crushing it into the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's a mechanism. Is Rustfire helping us?
Meanwhile, your communications device sounds.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Did you get attacked?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But it's not fatal. After all, it's not their goal to spread contamination, but to incite fear. People will be more susceptible to a different kind of Mania trap if their minds are weakened by this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They don't need a disguise anymore.
From the crack smashed open on the ground, black flames spill out slowly and flow upward, eventually gathering at the tip of the metal ball and forming a familiar figure.

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: It's you... It's you... You think you can glimpse it, you think you can escape...

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: Useless... It's useless... Mere worms, mere ants... will burn to ashes in the end...

It smiles menacingly and raises its hand. That nauseating mark emerges once again, and black flames begin blazing. Its voice grows loud suddenly, piercing the walls and ceilings, shaking the floors of the buildings.

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: Look at me... Look at me!!

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: Let us witness... its return!!!
